en: Color postcard showing a winter scene of a historic building with a clock on its gable and a red-tiled roof, identified as the Central Post Office in Brașov, Romania. Snow covers the ground and rooftops; bare trees frame the view under a blue sky. The reverse has the Romanian postal layout with a printed 40 bani indicium bearing the socialist coat of arms, address lines, and publisher/price details.
